subject: Fernway - p95 latency & errors after v2.1 quant profile
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fernway.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: priyA@fernway.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sudden p95 spike and 502s after v2.1 quant profile deploy

Stephanie —

We rolled the v2.1 quant profile (int8-optim) to production yesterday evening and overnight we started seeing a large p95 latency increase (from ~220ms to ~780ms) and a spike in 502/504 responses for our hotpath. The attached fernway_error_samples.log shows a lot of decode timeouts and KV cache churn around 02:30–03:15 UTC. Our user-facing error rate doubled and we have customers opening tickets.

Can Redwood confirm whether the v2.1 quant profile is being routed to Fernway's traffic and if there were any infra-side kernel changes? We need an ETA for mitigation — at minimum, a plan to stop the regressions or pin us back to the previous profile.

Priya and I are on standby. This is impacting payments flows.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Reliability, Fernway Financial

Attachments: fernway_error_samples.log

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fernway.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 spike and 502s after v2.1 quant profile deploy

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're treating this as high priority. Initial notes:

- Confirmed: an automated rollout of the v2.1 quant profile (label: qprof-v2.1-int8-optim) hit a subset of Fernway traffic last night per rollout policy.
- Impact we see in our telemetry: p95 increase, decoder stalls on some GPU types, and an uptick in 502s where the runtime timed out waiting on kernel paths.

Immediate actions I am triggering now:
1) Marcus will coordinate a targeted rollback to qprof-v2.0 for Fernway traffic.
2) Rishi will open an ops bridge and validate autoscale/queue backpressure settings.
3) Jordan will coordinate status updates with your CS/ops contact and confirm impact window.

Alex — can you confirm the time window to target for a rollback (we can do an immediate pin if you want us to take the hit)? Also sharing a Drive link to our initial capture: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/fernway-ops (I uploaded p95-trends.png).

Short term target: rollback within 45–60 minutes and monitoring for recovery. Longer term: we will run a kernel-selection audit for the combination of model variant + GPU type that triggered stalls.

- Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fernway.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 spike and 502s after v2.1 quant profile deploy

On it — immediate plan from runtime:
- Rolling a targeted pin now to revert Fernway to qprof-v2.0 (non-int8 path) on their production allocation. This will be a config change at the smart-routing layer; no model package redeploy required.
- Keeping qprof-v2.1 disabled for Fernway until we can repro the stalls on a controlled node.
- Will add a transient increase to the request timeout from 6s -> 10s during rollback window to reduce 502 surface while we stabilize.

I'll post updates in the bridge. Attaching an early check: p95-trends.png (uploaded).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: p95-trends.png

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 spike and 502s after v2.1 quant profile deploy

Bridge notes and triage summary (ops bridge RED-2345):
- Root cause hypothesis: qprof-v2.1 changed kernel selection heuristics for some attention/softmax kernels under sequence-length distribution typical for Fernway. On Ampere A100 nodes we observed higher memory copies and KV eviction churn leading to stalls.
- Immediate mitigations applied: rollback to qprof-v2.0 completed at 10:18 PST for Fernway; request-timeout bump applied; autoscale surge enabled (added 4 reserved slots) to relieve queueing.
- Preliminary post-rollback telemetry: p95 trending down from 780ms -> ~260ms over 25 minutes; error rate reduced but a residual 5xx tail remains under load.

Next steps:
1) Marcus to repro the stall in a staging cluster with v2.1 kernel config and capture nvprof traces.
2) Runtime team to prepare a compatibility report mapping qprof-v2.1 heuristics to GPU families.
3) PMR: schedule a rollback-confirmation call with Fernway and an executive summary to Marissa for visibility.

I'll keep the bridge open until we observe stable p95 below 300ms for 30 minutes.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya@fernway.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fernway.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T12:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 spike and 502s after v2.1 quant profile deploy

Thanks — appreciate the quick response and rollback. A couple asks from Fernway ops:
- Can Redwood provide the root-cause summary and a short ETA for a safe revalidation if we want to retry v2.1?
- We need a postmortem draft for our internal incident report (please share the logs you collected).

We are holding a command centre at 13:00 UTC and would like a short update for execs.

Priya
Priya Shah
Ops Lead, Fernway Financial
Attachment: fernway_error_samples.log (from our side)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.turner@fernway.com, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 spike and 502s after v2.1 quant profile deploy

Team — good triage and rapid rollback. Quick exec note for record and next steps for the postmortem:
- Action items for this afternoon: finalize the timeline (who changed what and when), collect nvprof traces, and produce a one-page executive summary for Fernway (include impact window, customer-visible metrics, mitigation & ETA for revalidation).
- Communication guidance: Jordan — please coordinate a 15-min briefing with Fernway execs and include the rollback confirmation and expected next-check timeline (we can promise an investigation update within 48 hours and a revalidation plan within 5 business days).
- Risk note: flag model-variant kernel-heuristic changes for staged canary on a per-GPU-family basis before any future automatic rollout. We will block qprof-v2.1 from global automated rollouts until compatibility report is complete.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
Attachment: postmortem-draft.docx
